_about: Transit under construction (engine/construction.py, engine/closures.py). Lines are drawn from OpenStreetMap ways whose name matches 'match' (fetched by engine/fetch_construction.py); a line with no OSM geometry yet is left off. Stations come from OSM where mapped, otherwise from 'stations': where the line crosses the named street ('cross', a street in streets.geojson). Only facts the owner has published go in 'opens'.

lines.name: Ontario Line
lines.about: A new subway from Exhibition Place through downtown to Don Valley station at Eglinton and Don Mills, partly elevated through Thorncliffe Park and Flemingdon Park.

lines.name: Line 2 East extension
lines.owner: Metrolinx; the TTC will run it
lines.about: Extends Line 2 Bloor–Danforth north-east from Kennedy to Sheppard Avenue and McCowan Road, replacing the closed Line 3.

lines.name: Eglinton Crosstown West extension
lines.owner: Metrolinx; the TTC will run it
lines.about: Extends Line 5 Eglinton west from Mount Dennis to Renforth Drive, mostly underground.

lines.name: Hazel McCallion Line
lines.about: Light rail along Hurontario Street from Port Credit GO in Mississauga to the Brampton Gateway Terminal.

closures._contractors: Consortiums that only build transit; their permits count even when not filed as Metrolinx. General contractors (e.g. Green Infrastructure Partners, which also does City sewer work) are left out: their Metrolinx permits still come in by tag.
